passages.text: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded. So Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years, until he turned and rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was king in Jerusalem.
Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylon.
During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar invaded Judah.
Jehoiakim became a servant to Nebuchadnezzar.
Jehoiakim served Nebuchadnezzar for three years.
After three years, Jehoiakim turned against Nebuchadnezzar.
Jehoiakim rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
passages.original: בְּיָמָ֣יו עָלָ֔ה נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיְהִי־ ל֨וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים עֶ֙בֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וַיָּ֖שָׁב וַיִּמְרָד־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And the LORD sent Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiders against Jehoiakim in order to destroy Judah, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servants the prophets.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted against Jehoiakim, king of Judah.
The LORD sent raiders from four nations.
He sent Chaldean raiders.
He sent Aramean raiders.
He sent Moabite raiders.
He sent Ammonite raiders.
The LORD sent these raiders into Judah.
He sent them to destroy Judah.
The LORD did this as He had spoken.
He spoke these words through His servants, the prophets.
passages.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀ בּ֡וֹ אֶת־ גְּדוּדֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּים֩ וְאֶת־ גְּדוּדֵ֨י אֲרָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת׀ גְּדוּדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֵת֙ גְּדוּדֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֔וֹן וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֥ם בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה לְהַֽאֲבִיד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

passages.text: Surely this happened to Judah at the LORD’s command, to remove them from His presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all that he had done, and also for the innocent blood he had shed. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD was unwilling to forgive.
passages.sermon:
The LORD commanded these things to happen to Judah.
The LORD wanted to remove Judah from His presence.
The LORD did this because of the sins of Manasseh.
Manasseh had done many evil things.
Manasseh had also shed innocent blood.
He filled Jerusalem with innocent blood.
The LORD was not willing to forgive.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה לְהָסִ֖יר מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו בְּחַטֹּ֣את מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃ וְגַ֤ם דַּֽם־ הַנָּקִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁפָ֔ךְ וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לִסְלֹֽחַ׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
He did many things.
He accomplished many acts.
The rest of Jehoiakim’s deeds are written in a book.
This book is called the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And Jehoiakim rested with his fathers, and his son Jehoiachin reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
Jehoiakim died.
Jehoiakim was buried with his ancestors.
Jehoiachin was Jehoiakim’s son.
Jehoiachin became king after Jehoiakim died.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: Now the king of Egypt did not march out of his land again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
passages.sermon: The king of Egypt did not leave his land again.\r\nThe king of Babylon had taken all the land that belonged to the king of Egypt.\r\nThis land stretched from the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ הֹסִ֥יף עוֹד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָצֵ֖את מֵֽאַרְצ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ לָקַ֞ח מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל מִנַּ֤חַל מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ נְהַר־ פְּרָ֔ת כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיְתָ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ

passages.text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiachin became king when he was eighteen years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for three months.
His mother was Nehushta.
Nehushta was the daughter of Elnathan.
Nehushta came from Jerusalem.
passages.original: בֶּן־ שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּ֥א בַת־ אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his father had done.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiachin was king of Judah.
He did evil things.
The LORD saw his evil actions.
Jehoiachin acted like his father.
His father also did evil things.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched up to Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
His servants marched to Jerusalem.
This happened at that time.
They surrounded the city.
Jerusalem came under siege.
passages.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא עָלָה עַבְדֵ֛י נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֥א הָעִ֖יר בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃

passages.text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it.
passages.sermon: Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.\r\nHe came to the city of Jerusalem.\r\nHis servants were already besieging the city.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֛א נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל עַל־ הָעִ֑יר וַעֲבָדָ֖יו צָרִ֥ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his servants, his commanders, and his officials all surrendered to the king of Babylon. So in the eighth year of his reign, the king of Babylon took him captive.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiachin was king of Judah.
His mother was with him.
His servants were with him.
His commanders were with him.
His officials were with him.
They all surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar was in the eighth year of his reign.
Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin captive.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א יְהוֹיָכִ֤ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל ה֣וּא וְאִמּ֔וֹ וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְשָׂרָ֣יו וְסָֽרִיסָ֑יו וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃

passages.text: As the LORD had declared, Nebuchadnezzar also carried off all the treasures from the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and he cut into pieces all the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
The LORD had declared what would happen.
Nebuchadnezzar took all the treasures from the house of the LORD.
He also took all the treasures from the royal palace.
Solomon was the king of Israel.
Solomon had made gold articles for the temple of the LORD.
Nebuchadnezzar cut all these gold articles into pieces.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א מִשָּׁ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ אוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֽוֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיְקַצֵּ֞ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He carried into exile all Jerusalem—all the commanders and mighty men of valor, all the craftsmen and metalsmiths—ten thousand captives in all. Only the poorest people of the land remained.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
He took the people of Jerusalem into exile.
He carried away all the commanders from Jerusalem.
He carried away all the mighty men of valor from Jerusalem.
He took ten thousand people as captives.
He also took all the craftsmen from Jerusalem.
He also took all the metalsmiths from Jerusalem.
He left only the poorest people of the land.
No one else remained in Jerusalem except the poor.
passages.original: וְהִגְלָ֣ה אֶת־ כָּל־ יְ֠רוּשָׁלִַם וְֽאֶת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֞ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל עֲשָׂרָה אֲלָפִים֙ גּוֹלֶ֔ה וְכָל־ הֶחָרָ֖שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּ֑ר לֹ֣א נִשְׁאַ֔ר זוּלַ֖ת דַּלַּ֥ת עַם־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Nebuchadnezzar carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, as well as the king’s mother, his wives, his officials, and the leading men of the land. He took them into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin away to Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar also took the king’s mother to Babylon.
He took the king’s wives to Babylon.
He took the king’s officials to Babylon.
He took the leading men of the land to Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar led all these people into exile.
He took them from Jerusalem to Babylon.
passages.original: וַיֶּ֥גֶל אֶת־ יְהוֹיָכִ֖ין בָּבֶ֑לָה וְאֶת־ אֵ֣ם הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־ נְשֵׁ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְאֶת־ סָרִיסָ֗יו וְאֵת֙ אֱוִלֵי הָאָ֔רֶץ הוֹלִ֛יךְ גּוֹלָ֥ה מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃

passages.text: The king of Babylon also brought into exile to Babylon all seven thousand men of valor and a thousand craftsmen and metalsmiths—all strong and fit for battle.
passages.sermon:
The king of Babylon took many people from Jerusalem.
He took seven thousand men of valor.
These men were strong and fit for battle.
He also took one thousand craftsmen and metalsmiths.
All these people were exiled to Babylon.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַחַ֜יִל שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֗ים וְהֶחָרָ֤שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר֙ אֶ֔לֶף הַכֹּ֕ל גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֣י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וַיְבִיאֵ֧ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל גּוֹלָ֖ה בָּבֶֽלָה׃

passages.text: Then the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.
passages.sermon:
The king of Babylon acted with authority over Jerusalem.
He removed Jehoiachin from being king.
He chose Mattaniah to be king instead.
Mattaniah was Jehoiachin’s uncle.
The king of Babylon changed Mattaniah’s name.
He gave him the name Zedekiah.
passages.original: וַיַּמְלֵ֧ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־ מַתַּנְיָ֥ה דֹד֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃פ

passages.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
passages.sermon:
Zedekiah became king when he was twenty-one years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for eleven years.
His mother was Hamutal.
Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah.
She came from Libnah.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַחַ֤ת שָׁנָה֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ חֲמִיטַל בַּֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃

passages.text: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
passages.sermon:
Zedekiah was king of Judah.
He did evil things.
The LORD saw Zedekiah’s evil.
Jehoiakim was a king before Zedekiah.
Jehoiakim also did evil things.
Zedekiah did evil in the same way as Jehoiakim.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽים׃

passages.text: For because of the anger of the LORD, all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until He finally banished them from His presence. And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon.
passages.sermon:
The LORD became angry with Jerusalem and Judah.
His anger caused all these things to happen there.
He stayed angry until He removed the people from His presence.
Zedekiah was king in Jerusalem.
Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ עַל־ אַ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה בִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּבִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ הִשְׁלִכ֥וֹ אֹתָ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּמְרֹ֥ד צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃ס
